questions.stem:
Which of the following are solutions of the equation x2 − 5x = 0?
Indicate all such solutions.
What percent of Company M's employees work in IT?
What is the ratio of the number of employees in Sales to the number of employees in HR?
How many more employees work in Sales and Operations combined than in IT, HR, and Finance combined?
